# SmartCard

> NFC-powered digital business cards and bio-link profiles. One tap shares your contact, socials, portfolio, and links.

SmartCard combines premium programmable NFC hardware (cards, tags, stickers) with a hosted profile builder (SmartLink Bio) so creators and professionals can share everything they are with a single tap.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of SmartCard — how the NFC tap-to-share flow works.
- [SmartLink Bio](/smartlink-bio): Digital profile builder, templates, analytics, and plans.
- [NFC Products](/nfc-products): Shop programmable NFC cards, tags, and stickers; customize designs.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Browse pre-designed templates and profiles from the community.
- [Learn](/learn): Help center, tutorials, and frequently asked questions.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the SmartCard team.
